shadshiny inputs are drop-in replacements for their base Shiny counterparts:
same `inputId` in, same `input$id` out. This vignette maps the common ones and
flags where the value shape differs.

## Mapping table

| base Shiny | shadshiny | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `textInput()` | `shad_input()` | `type=` for email/password/number. |
| `textAreaInput()` | `shad_textarea()` | `autosize = TRUE` grows with content. |
| `numericInput()` | `shad_input(type = "number")` | Value returns as entered; coerce server-side. |
| `checkboxInput()` | `shad_checkbox()` | Adds a tri-state `"indeterminate"` option. |
| `checkboxGroupInput()` | `shad_toggle_group(type = "multiple")` | Returns a character vector of selected values. |
| `radioButtons()` | `shad_radio_group()` | Single string value. |
| `selectInput()` | `shad_select()` | Single value. |
| `selectInput(multiple = TRUE)` | `shad_combobox(multiple = TRUE)` | Searchable; returns a character vector. |
| `sliderInput()` | `shad_slider()` | Two-element `value` makes it a range. |
| `sliderInput()` (range) | `shad_slider(value = c(lo, hi))` | Returns a length-2 numeric. |
| `dateInput()` | `shad_date_picker()` | Value is an ISO `"YYYY-MM-DD"` string. |
| `dateRangeInput()` | `shad_date_picker(mode = "range")` | Value is `list(start, end)`. |
| `actionButton()` | `shad_button()` | Same action-button semantics + `variant`/`size`. |
| `tabsetPanel()` / `tabPanel()` | `shad_tabs()` / `shad_tab()` | `input$id` is the active tab value. |

## Value-shape differences to watch

- **Multi-value inputs return character vectors.** `shad_combobox(multiple =
  TRUE)` and `shad_toggle_group(type = "multiple")` give you `c("a", "b")`, not
  a comma-joined string.
- **Range inputs return structured values.** `shad_slider(value = c(20, 80))`
  reports `c(20, 80)`; `shad_date_picker(mode = "range")` reports
  `list(start = ..., end = ...)`.
- **Dates are ISO strings.** Convert with `as.Date(input$id)` when you need a
  `Date`.
- **Checkbox tri-state.** `shad_checkbox()` can report `"indeterminate"` in
  addition to `TRUE`/`FALSE`; guard with `isTRUE(input$id)`.

## Updating from the server

Base `updateXxxInput()` calls become `update_shad_*()`:

```{r}
# base Shiny
updateSelectInput(session, "plan", selected = "pro")
updateSliderInput(session, "range", value = c(10, 40))

# shadshiny
update_shad_select("plan", selected = "pro")
update_shad_slider("range", value = c(10, 40))
```

## Components with no base equivalent

Some shadshiny components have no direct Shiny analogue and are worth adopting
on their own:

- `shad_command()` — a ⌘K command palette with grouped, keyword-searchable
  items.
- `shad_input_otp()` — segmented one-time-code entry.
- `shad_sidebar_layout()` — a full collapsible application sidebar with groups,
  items, badges, and a server-toggled state.
- `shad_toast()` — server-raised notifications, including loading→done flows.

See `vignette("shadshiny")` to get started and `shad_run_example("kitchen-sink")`
for a live tour.
